text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both flat to slightly down, reflecting cautious sentiment as the Fear & Greed index sits at 28—deep in fear territory and declining further over the past week. BTC dominance holding steady at 56.6% suggests capital isn't rotating aggressively into alts, though smaller caps like BNB show modest resilience. The $65B in 24h volume is moderate, indicating limited conviction in either direction as markets consolidate under risk-off conditions.
